Without prejudice to the recommended dimensions, it is vital for safety reasons that the vehicle is fitted with tyres of the same make and type on all wheels.

It is not advisable to travel for long distances with the tyres not inflated to the specified pressure (wheels partly or totally deflated) because this could cause damage to the viscous coupling (4x4 versions).
